# ROS 2 Kubernetes Lab

> ROS 2 Kubernetes Lab is an open-source educational and research lab for running ROS 2 robotics software on Kubernetes. It has a ROS 2 Jazzy container image with a same-container talker/listener test, a historical three-VM Vagrant and Kubernetes cluster, DDS discovery guides, monitoring examples and a set of research scenario proposals. It is not a production robot platform and makes no real-time or safety guarantees.

## Status in one paragraph

- Container tested: a ROS 2 Jazzy / Ubuntu 24.04 image builds in CI and a talker and listener exchange messages inside one container.
- Legacy: the Vagrant cluster and the root-level Kubernetes manifests use ROS 2 Foxy (end of life), Kubernetes 1.29 and Weave Net. `ROS2/ros_dep_1.yaml` starts a stress-ng workload, not a talker/listener.
- Not yet verified: ROS 2 messages crossing between Kubernetes pods or worker nodes on a modern profile (tracked in issue #14).
- The research scenarios are proposals. No Jev integration, model benchmark, real robot control or measured result is published.

## Start here

- [Home](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/): what the lab is, the two ways to start, the architecture and the roadmap.
- [Docs hub](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/docs/): field guide index.
- [Getting started](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/docs/getting-started.html): the tested Jazzy container path and the historical Vagrant path.
- [Architecture](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/docs/architecture.html): the layers from VMs to DDS to monitoring.
- [Learning paths](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/docs/lab-paths.html): routes for students, engineers and researchers.
- [Contribute](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/docs/contribute.html): how to pick an issue and open a pull request.

## Roadmap (a 90-day proposal, not a promise)

- [Roadmap hub](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/): four phases and one gate, with the issues behind each.
- [Days 1-14: define the reference path](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/define-reference-path.html)
- [Days 15-30: make it runnable and safe](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/runnable-and-safe.html)
- [Days 31-60: package and document](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/package-and-document.html)
- [Days 61-90: grow with evidence](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/grow-with-evidence.html)
- [Release gates: the definition of done](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/plans/release-gates.html)

## Research scenarios (proposals with synthetic, animated explanations)

- [Scenario hub](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/)
- [ROS 2 DDS and QoS fault triage](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/ros2-fault-triage.html)
- [Edge and cloud inference placement](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/edge-cloud-inference.html)
- [LLM agent skill screening in a simulator](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/robot-agent-safety.html)
- [Fair multi-robot task dispatch](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/multi-robot-scheduling.html)
- [Results registry](https://mskazemi.com/ros2-kubernetes-lab/scenarios/results.html): every primary outcome is empty until human-reviewed raw evidence exists.
